immutability: Once published, this file is never edited. A legitimate byte change gets a new version. These bytes are what an independent implementation is checked against; editing them to match new code would remove the only thing that makes the check meaningful.
carriage: Each `bytes` value is the complete payload of one Link frame whose frame_class is HANDOFF (8). The frame's payload_len delimits it exactly.

negative.name: truncated_header
negative.why: Nine bytes. The operation is readable but the fixed header is not complete, and more bytes could still complete it.

negative.name: empty
negative.why: A carriage that delivers nothing has not delivered a malformed control.

negative.name: truncated_challenge
negative.why: Seventeen bytes: a PATH_CHALLENGE one byte short of its challenge.

negative.name: trailing_byte
negative.why: Eleven bytes for a ten-byte COMMIT. The frame already declared its payload length, so excess is a format disagreement, not a boundary question.

negative.name: challenge_on_commit
negative.why: A COMMIT sized as though it carried a challenge. The operation determines the length; nothing else may.

negative.name: challenge_absent_on_path_challenge
negative.why: A PATH_CHALLENGE sized as though it carried no challenge.

negative.name: reserved_operation
negative.why: Operation 0 is permanently reserved so a zeroed buffer can never decode.

negative.name: all_zero
negative.why: Every zero-forbidden field is zero at once. The single case most likely to arise from an uninitialised buffer.

negative.name: unassigned_operation
negative.why: Operation 5 is unassigned. Every handoff operation is critical, so an unknown one is rejected rather than skipped.

negative.name: experimental_operation
negative.why: Operation 192 is Experimental Use. An implementation not party to the experiment rejects it exactly as it rejects an unassigned value.

negative.name: wrong_control_version
negative.why: Version is checked before operation, so a future control version is reported as a version mismatch rather than as nonsense.

negative.name: future_version_unknown_operation
negative.why: Pins the ordering: a future version carrying an operation this build does not know still reports the version, not the operation.

negative.name: zero_migration_ref
negative.why: A control with no transaction cannot be correlated with the offer that started it.

negative.name: zero_session_ref
negative.why: A control arriving on a transport the contact has not been using must say which contact it belongs to.
